text:
deploybot: Deploy attempt blocked by CI gate for release tag v2.14.0 -> prod. Environment: prod-canary->prod. Commit: ab12cd34. Failing checks: integration-tests (suite-ui), coverage diff -3.2%, license-scan. CI: https://ci.example.com/builds/7890

alice.r: Got it. Who can triage the integration failure? @dmitri.k

dmitri.k: On it, grabbing logs.

dmitri.k: Looks like `payment_flow_e2e::checkout_hangs` failing with timeout in chrome headless. Stack:
```
TimeoutError: 30000ms exceeded
    at Object.<anonymous> (/usr/src/app/tests/payment_checkout.test.js:45:12)
```

maya.qa: Flaky or new regression? When did this start showing up?

dmitri.k: Failure started in commit `ab12cd34` — added a new mock for payment provider response. Reproduced in CI image.

alice.r: Options: 1) pin prod back to v2.13.9, 2) rollback, or 3) hotfix + rerun CI. Change window closes in 45m.

ben.s: If we pin we need a rollback orchestration step. I can hold and execute pin if we choose that.

carla.p: Any user-facing impact yet? Is canary seeing errors?

deploybot: Canary traffic: 10% — error rate up to 0.8% (baseline 0.02%).

dmitri.k: I'll revert the payment mock in a hotfix PR. Estimated fix <30m. Recommend hotfix + rerun if quick.

alice.r: Given the change window, prefer hotfix + rerun if under 30m. Approving the plan. @ben.s hold pin.

ben.s: Holding pin. If CI doesn't pass by +40m I'll pin to v2.13.9.

maya.qa: I'll run focused e2e on the branch and post back.

dmitri.k: Pushed hotfix PR #4521 -> CI started: https://ci.example.com/builds/7898

deploybot: CI update: build 7898 -> integration-tests failing (same test) at 2300004380.

dmitri.k: Hmm. Reproduced locally using the runner docker image — looks like infra or flaky timeout rather than mock.

ben.s: Given repeated failures and rising error rate, recommend pinning to stable. Proceeding with pin now.

deploybot: Action taken: pinned production release to tag v2.13.9 by ben.s at 2300004420. New deploy queued.

alice.r: Thanks team. Follow-up: add `payment_flow_e2e::checkout_hangs` to flaky-tests list and add a timeout increase / stability check. I'll file the ticket.

maya.qa: :thumbsup: will validate smoke after pin.

deploybot: Deploy resumed using tag v2.13.9. Canary->prod deploy succeeded at 2300004450.
